title: Design System: The Last Acquisition — Print

footer.purpose: Footer and brief handling text; not the narrative floor.

styles.van_gogh: public single-page introduction and three invitation portraits

artwork.fit: centered aspect-fit; full composition; no stretching or cropping
artwork.source: Full-resolution committed JPEGs in assets/portraits and organizer source ZIP; exact prompts, identity specifications and hashes in source/art_direction.json. Native generated PNGs remain at the image tool local locations.
artwork.public: 90 Portraits JPEG derivatives and 30 introduction PNGs carry harmless origin metadata. Exact prompts remain organizer-only.
artwork.branchBehavior: The same character art is used regardless of guilt; later private rounds contain no illustrations.

narrative.overview: Flat white-stock documents use Libron book typography, Meridian blue identity fields, and practical spacing for reading, handwriting, cutting, and sealing. The gala belongs to 2026; costumes are optional. The Living Collection adds 90 distinct artworks for 30 fictional identities, preserving recognizable features across Van Gogh inspired public portraits, Picasso inspired private portraits and chibi place-card avatars.
keyCharacteristics: Four pages: background, Motive, Opportunity, Method
Safe speech boxes with outside IF INNOCENT / IF MURDERER labels
Neutral vertically stacked A/B setup receipts
Nine-page tailored question catalog per seating pair
ID roster with Here / R1 / R2 / R3 ticks
Centered aspect-fit portraits with ivory matte
Four museum-label place cards per Letter sheet
Three public Van Gogh portraits on the invitation
Organizer-only exact prompts and harmless public provenance

rules.name: Narrative floor
rules.body: Preserve 14 pt narrative text; introductory prose measures between 16 and 18 pt.

rules.name: Neutral evidence labels
rules.body: Both A/B branches use neutral setup-receipt titles; the intersection of salon entry, cabinet-key access and matching linen establishes guilt.

rules.name: Full composition
rules.body: Center artwork using the smaller slot-to-image scale; never stretch or crop the composition.

rules.name: Artwork privacy
rules.body: Character artwork is identical across guilt branches. Keep exact prompts organizer-only and public provenance harmless.

dos: Preserve the implemented Motive, Opportunity and Method sequence.
Memorize animals and immediately return slips to a closed box.
Keep branch selection labels outside speech boxes.
Keep the FINALE tray with the host until ballots are collected.
Use one complete tailored question catalog per seating pair.
Print single-sided at 100% and cut dashed borders.
Embed PDF fonts without shipping standalone font binaries.
Preserve each fictional identity across its three distinct artworks.
Review all 90 assets and rendered placements when artwork or geometry changes.
Keep full-resolution JPEGs in the organizer source ZIP and 900 px derivatives in public Portraits.
donts: Do not replace the independent homepage system.
Do not send private packets as pre-party introductions.
Do not put confessions inside playable packets.
Do not shrink narrative text to conceal overflow.
Do not expose exact prompts in public derivatives.
Do not add branch-dependent portraits or illustrations to later private rounds.
Do not stretch or crop character artwork.
